svg.aria-label: Browsers: Browsers talk to studio only. Studio talks to the services. Login: synthwerk-identity provides login, users and roles. Chat and AI: synthwerk-llm provides chat and AI settings. Live health: Live health streams from synthwerk-pulse over SSE
